completion_rule: all required gates and all listed cases pass with current evidence; all targeted mutations are killed by behavioral assertions

parameters.coordinate_numeric_tolerance_note: Choose float roundoff tolerance from the actual synthetic fixture implementation; do not confuse it with physical LiDAR accuracy.
parameters.within_reach_rule: complete finite supplied profile and supported target/local floor; conservative interval entirely inside supplied geometric envelope; modeled reach corridor clear; missing required evidence prevents positive status

cases.input: Prior hardcoded demonstration and complete progress file
cases.expect: Preserved and relabeled as synthetic/unverified; no script can emit real-completion claim from it

cases.input: Wall/table nodes with attachment omitted, undefined or null
cases.expect: Zero outlets

cases.input: Wall-mounted whiteboard attachment plus one real outlet and one candidate
cases.expect: Only explicit outlet categories included; candidates distinguished; whiteboard excluded

cases.input: Actual production discovery entry with calibrated wall/mesh and detector transport fixture
cases.expect: Surface outlet persisted to candidate revision and returned through authenticated graph API; not discarded by solid carving

cases.input: Replay the same full discovery inputs twice
cases.expect: Same stable outlet IDs and no duplicate evidence or nodes

cases.input: Asymmetric image at 0/90/180/270 degrees; off-center resized crops and overlapping tiles
cases.expect: Expected sensor-pixel boxes and source crop map correctly; no double rotation or x/y swap

cases.input: Malformed/reversed/out-of-bounds/NaN/Inf boxes and unresolved socket count
cases.expect: Reject malformed data; preserve unknown count; never invent duplex sockets

cases.input: Provider timeout/auth error versus valid empty result
cases.expect: Explicit distinguishable errors; bounded retry only for transient failures; error not cached as empty success

cases.input: Structured detector sockets/crop/category/caveats followed by cache replay
cases.expect: Metadata unchanged; changed schema/prompt/image/calibration invalidates relevant cache

cases.input: Actual evidence route under owning user with generated crop
cases.expect: Decodable bytes match source pixel region and manifest hash; missing crop explicit error

cases.input: Second user/anonymous requester guesses crop ID or supplies traversal path
cases.expect: Denied per existing policy; no bytes, raw source path or secret leakage

cases.input: Existing camera fixture looking +Y; wall Y=1.95; box [550,220,590,260]; camera-Z buffer 1.95
cases.expect: Visible same-wall support is not rejected because normalized-ray distance exceeds camera Z

cases.input: Same wall with genuine foreground occluder
cases.expect: No verified support assigned through occluder

cases.input: Missing/all-infinite depth, mesh hole, grazing/degenerate ray
cases.expect: Missing visibility retained as uncertainty; no verified-LiDAR/clear-reach pass

cases.input: RoomPlan node marked measured but only box-face intersection available
cases.expect: Inferred plane provenance; not measured triangle support

cases.input: Known nonidentity capture-to-room-to-floor transform; socket local/world frame; variable intrinsics
cases.expect: One explicit coordinate convention and transform applied once; correct expected positions

cases.input: Two distinct consistent views of one faceplate
cases.expect: One identity with both source observations; no unsupported socket inference

cases.input: Nearby separate plates, opposite wall sides and ambiguous A-B-C chain
cases.expect: Distinct fixtures do not collapse through proximity or transitive weak evidence

cases.input: Centers (0,2,1) and (0.04,2,1), projections outside recorded boxes [100,100,200,200]
cases.expect: Positive camera depth alone does not authorize merge

cases.input: Merge/reorder detected and owner-rejected observations with different caveats
cases.expect: Owner decision and all relevant uncertainty survive, or explicit conflict; result cannot silently become detected/verified

cases.input: Repeated near-identical frames with reordered execution
cases.expect: No inflated independent-view count or duplicated evidence; stable replay identity

cases.input: Missing profile, missing vertical limits, missing required hand reference
cases.expect: Needs verification; no implicit ADA/personal dimensions

cases.input: NaN/Inf/negative maximum reach, inverted height bounds, invalid units
cases.expect: Validation rejection and no within-reach result

cases.input: Missing local floor/support/normal or unresolved socket target
cases.expect: Unknown required quantities; no world-zero/first-floor/faceplate-center substitution producing positive reach

cases.input: Declared exact synthetic socket and complete profiles: horizontal distance 0.60m, limits 0.80m versus 0.40m, valid vertical bounds
cases.expect: Different modeled reach outcomes with identical geometry, not changed fixture assessments

cases.input: Distance interval [0.55,0.65]m and limit 0.60m; corresponding height-threshold crossing
cases.expect: Needs verification; no arbitrary 90-percent confidence rule

cases.input: Floor elevation 1.0m; socket world elevation 1.5m
cases.expect: Height above floor 0.5m consistently in calculation, panel and export

cases.input: Clear endpoint with wall blocking direct route but a valid detour
cases.expect: Find tested detour or explicit bounded-search unknown; no false straight-line route/physical impossibility claim

cases.input: Floor gap, no floor, invalid start and narrow passage below chair footprint
cases.expect: No clear route through unsupported/blocked region; causes distinguished

cases.input: Thin obstacle/floor gap located between coarse sampling points
cases.expect: Swept collision/coverage test prevents tunneling

cases.input: Target (0,0), chair near (0,0.65), barrier x=[-2,2] z=[0.13,0.17] at relevant reach height
cases.expect: Reach obstruction detected even though neither endpoint touches the barrier; not unconditional within_reach

cases.input: Far-side wall socket and parent cabinet between hand and socket
cases.expect: No approach through wall or reach through parent furniture

cases.input: Search exceeds expansion cap or current chair position is unknown
cases.expect: Explicit inconclusive/unknown, no invented origin or route distance

cases.input: Actual outlet selected in authenticated app with available crop
cases.expect: Decoded readable photograph, source ID and separate approach/reach/status explanations visible

cases.input: Click preview for an assessed outlet destination different from generic object docking
cases.expect: Actual controller receives evaluated path/destination and preserves collision checks; outlet kinds supported

cases.input: Edit actual personal-reach controls and chair/start position
cases.expect: Inputs validated; stale assessment invalidated; real computation updates panel

cases.input: 390x844, wheelchair mode, keyboard/list navigation and error/empty states
cases.expect: Evidence and controls usable; no reliance on color or 3D picking alone; no physical-device claim

cases.input: Owner reject/correct-location through API, reload, then full discovery rerun
cases.expect: Decision and provenance survive; rejects do not regain affirmative guidance

cases.input: Support moved, calibration replaced, scene revision advanced or conflicting owner edit
cases.expect: Stale evidence/assessment invalidated; optimistic concurrency prevents stale overwrite

cases.input: Download assessment after real UI profile/review change
cases.expect: Revision, profile or absence, evidence, route/reach, local height and uncertainty agree with UI

cases.input: Another user edits reviews or downloads architecture/evidence export
cases.expect: Authorization denied without modifying owner state

cases.input: All eight targeted mutants in isolated copy
cases.expect: 8/8 trigger behavior assertions, not compile errors; original working-tree content preserved

cases.input: Locked preserved Moffett photo/camera/geometry manifest and configured detector
cases.expect: Actual automatic detector and production pipeline persist at least one photo-supported outlet/candidate; no finished nodes injected

cases.input: Selected real outlet's crop/support/provenance inspected against sources
cases.expect: Photographic identity supported and localization accurately qualified; no invented count/geometry/confidence

cases.input: Real candidate revision selected, evidence viewed, profile changed, correction saved/reloaded, export fetched
cases.expect: Recorded actual authenticated journey; unknown personal reach allowed; no fixture substitution

cases.input: All real-acceptance artifacts and run receipts
cases.expect: Input/output/source hashes, detector mode and candidate revision match; no synthetic-completion records reused

cases.input: Affected pipeline/API/contracts tests, generated contracts, web typecheck/tests and applicable lint/build
cases.expect: Required checks actually run and pass; unrelated/preexisting failures explicitly separated

cases.input: Missing test, skipped result, failed exit, stale source hash or absent artifact
cases.expect: Completion verifier fails and cannot emit verified_web_feature

cases.input: Synthetic artifact substituted for real capture; absent crop/browser evidence; wrong revision; mismatched UI/export status
cases.expect: Completion verifier fails with specific reason

cases.input: All current gate/test/mutation and declared-scope acceptance receipts present
cases.expect: Verifier can emit verified_web_feature; native/device limitations remain separate and explicit

mutations.change: Replace persisted review with component state
